accepted.s: Which platform functions as a cloud locker for storing digital documents and was launched in February 2015?
accepted.x: DigiLocker is MeitY’s cloud-based document locker, launched in February 2015.
accepted.tq: Use the service-function association to distinguish document storage from authentication and pension services.
accepted.sec: Citizen service platforms - ministry + service  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. UMANG provides access to services of central, state and local governments through one mobile application.
2. DigiLocker is primarily a cloud locker for digital documents.
3. e-Sign enables Aadhaar-based signing of electronic documents.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. UMANG is a unified service app, DigiLocker stores documents, and e-Sign facilitates Aadhaar-based electronic signatures.
accepted.tq: Match each platform with its distinctive core service before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Citizen service platforms - ministry + service  [APPSC]

accepted.s: As reported in the India Year Book 2026, which one of the following correctly represents the user and service coverage of UMANG?
o: 8.68 crore users and 2,339 services from 240 departments
110.26 crore e-Signs and 29.07 crore CDAC e-Signs
accepted.x: The India Year Book 2026 figures for UMANG are 8.68 crore users and 2,339 services from 240 departments.
accepted.tq: Separate platform-specific figures instead of associating every large number with the most familiar service.
accepted.sec: Citizen service platforms - ministry + service  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: e-Pramaan is the national e-Authentication framework. SARATHI concerns driving licences, VAHAN concerns vehicle registration, and Bhavishya is an integrated pensioners’ portal.
accepted.tq: Check the precise function of each neighbouring transport, pension and authentication platform.
accepted.sec: Citizen service platforms - ministry + service  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The SAML-based single sign-on framework associated with the national e-Authentication service is:
accepted.x: e-Pramaan is the national e-Authentication framework and uses SAML-based single sign-on.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the authentication framework from the broader single-sign-on service and its backend components.
accepted.sec: Citizen service platforms - ministry + service  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Meri Pehchaan is associated with which of the following?
o: A digital life certificate service for pensioners
A national single sign-on service integrating 15,024 services
A national telemedicine service for remote consultations
accepted.x: Meri Pehchaan is a MeitY single sign-on service, with 15,024 services integrated. Its backend includes Parichay or Jan-Parichay, e-Pramaan and DigiLocker.
accepted.tq: Use the stated scale and backend relationship to identify the single-sign-on platform.
accepted.sec: Citizen service platforms - ministry + service  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following services is correctly matched with its principal function?
1. VAHAN — Vehicle registration
2. Bhavishya — Pension processing
3. Jeevan Pramaan — Digital life certificate for pensioners
4. e-Hospital — Online patient registration and appointments
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: All four pairs are correct. VAHAN handles vehicle registration, Bhavishya supports pension processing, Jeevan Pramaan provides digital life certificates, and e-Hospital supports online patient services.
accepted.tq: Verify each service by its operating domain before accepting the all-inclusive option.
accepted.sec: Citizen service platforms - ministry + service  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the organisation or ministry associated with it?
o: MyGov — Department of Pension and Pensioners’ Welfare
e-Sanjeevani — Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
e-Hospital — Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
e-Office — Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare
accepted.x: e-Sanjeevani is the national telemedicine service of the Health and Family Welfare sector. e-Hospital is associated with Health and NIC, MyGov with MeitY, and e-Office with MeitY/NIC.
accepted.tq: Apply the ministry-body association and reject swapped departmental ownership.
accepted.sec: Citizen service platforms - ministry + service  [APPSC]

accepted.s: MyGov, launched in 2014, is primarily a platform for:
accepted.x: MyGov is a MeitY citizen-engagement platform focused on participation and engagement relating to government policy.
accepted.tq: Identify the platform by its participatory policy function rather than by a transactional service.
accepted.sec: Citizen service platforms - ministry + service  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which project is associated with computerised treasury operations rather than online land records?
accepted.x: Khajane is Karnataka’s computerised treasury project, whereas Bhoomi is associated with online land records.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between two projects from the same state by their distinct administrative functions.
accepted.sec: State e-governance projects - state + service, state FIRSTs  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below.

List-I (Project)
a. Bhoomi
b. Akshaya
c. Lokvani
d. Gyandoot

List-II (State or location)
i. Madhya Pradesh — Dhar
ii. Karnataka
iii. Uttar Pradesh — Sitapur
iv. Kerala — Malappuram
accepted.x: Bhoomi is in Karnataka, Akshaya began in Malappuram in Kerala, Lokvani is associated with Sitapur in Uttar Pradesh, and Gyandoot with Dhar in Madhya Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure state-project pairs and then complete the location matching.
accepted.sec: State e-governance projects - state + service, state FIRSTs  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: e-Seva — Andhra Pradesh — Integrated citizen services and bill payments
FRIENDS — Kerala — Single-window utility bill payments
SETU — Maharashtra — Citizen facilitation centres for certificates
Lokvani — Madhya Pradesh — Online grievance redress kiosks
accepted.x: Lokvani is associated with Sitapur in Uttar Pradesh, not Madhya Pradesh. Gyandoot is the Madhya Pradesh project linked with rural G2C kiosks.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong state-project pairing by comparing each project with its stated service location.
accepted.sec: State e-governance projects - state + service, state FIRSTs  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The project that began in Dhar in 2000 as an intranet-based rural government-to-citizen kiosk system was:
accepted.x: Gyandoot was an intranet-based rural G2C kiosk project launched in Dhar, Madhya Pradesh, in 2000.
accepted.tq: Link the year, place and technological mode to identify the project.
accepted.sec: State e-governance projects - state + service, state FIRSTs  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Akshaya was initially started in Malappuram as a district-wide project mainly for:
accepted.x: Akshaya began in Malappuram, Kerala, as a district-wide e-literacy project and developed into rural IT and citizen service centres.
accepted.tq: Use the origin district and initial purpose to distinguish Akshaya from other state projects.
accepted.sec: State e-governance projects - state + service, state FIRSTs  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. e-Mitra — Rajasthan
2. e-Sewa — Punjab
3. Sewa Setu — Assam
4. Project Ganga — Uttar Pradesh
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correct. e-Mitra, e-Sewa and Sewa Setu are state service-delivery platforms of Rajasthan, Punjab and Assam respectively, while Project Ganga is associated with Uttar Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Check each state-platform association separately before selecting the complete combination.
accepted.sec: State e-governance projects - state + service, state FIRSTs  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Project Ganga, associated with Uttar Pradesh in 2026, is intended to provide:
o: Computerised treasury management through state finance departments
Last-mile rural broadband through local Digital Service Providers
A national framework for Aadhaar-based electronic signatures
A single-window system for utility bill payments in Kerala
accepted.x: Project Ganga is described as a digital expressway providing last-mile rural broadband through local Digital Service Providers in Uttar Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Identify the project from its infrastructure objective and implementation mechanism.
accepted.sec: State e-governance projects - state + service, state FIRSTs  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which State became the first in India to launch e-Cabinet?
accepted.x: Himachal Pradesh was the first State to launch e-Cabinet.
accepted.tq: Recall the state FIRST separately from state service-delivery projects.
accepted.sec: State e-governance projects - state + service, state FIRSTs  [APPSC]

accepted.s: GIMS is correctly described as:
o: Government Integrated Monitoring System, used for land-record digitisation
Government Instant Messaging System, released as the Sandes app for secure government communication
General Internet Mail Service, operated by the Department of Posts
Government Identity Management Service, used exclusively for pension authentication
accepted.x: GIMS stands for Government Instant Messaging System. It is India’s in-house secure messaging alternative and was released as the Sandes app, built by NIC.
accepted.tq: Expand the acronym first, then verify its communication purpose and implementing body.
accepted.sec: Government secure messaging and e-mail - Sandes/GIMS, NIC mail, regional-language e-mail  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following is integrated with NIC Mail?
1. CollabFiles office suite
2. e-Sign
3. Bhashini
4. Parichay single sign-on
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: NIC Mail is integrated with CollabFiles, e-Sign, Bhashini and the Parichay single sign-on service.
accepted.tq: Recognise the complete integration list and avoid treating NIC Mail as only an e-mail service.
accepted.sec: Government secure messaging and e-mail - Sandes/GIMS, NIC mail, regional-language e-mail  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about NIC Mail is correct?
o: It is the official government e-mail service.
It is the national telemedicine service of the Health Ministry.
It is a state-level land-record platform of Karnataka.
It is the single-window utility payment platform of Kerala.
accepted.x: NIC Mail is the official government e-mail service and is integrated with several government digital platforms.
accepted.tq: Use the institutional identity of the service rather than confusing it with a citizen-facing portal.
accepted.sec: Government secure messaging and e-mail - Sandes/GIMS, NIC mail, regional-language e-mail  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: e-Pathshala — Department of Pension and Pensioners’ Welfare; pension portal
DIKSHA — NCERT and Ministry of Education; Bharti Airtel operates its online platforms end to end
SWAYAM — Ministry of Health and Family Welfare; hospital management platform
PM eVIDYA — Ministry of Road Transport and Highways; vehicle registration service
accepted.x: DIKSHA is associated with NCERT and the Ministry of Education, while Bharti Airtel runs its online platforms end to end. The other pairs assign unrelated functions or ministries.
accepted.tq: Watch for swapped ministries and distinguish education platforms by their operators and functions.
accepted.sec: Education e-services - launching body or operator  [APPSC]

accepted.s: SWAYAM is primarily a:
accepted.x: SWAYAM is the Ministry of Education’s MOOC platform.
accepted.tq: Identify the platform through its delivery model—massive open online courses.
accepted.sec: Education e-services - launching body or operator  [APPSC]

accepted.s: PM eVIDYA, introduced in 2020, is intended to provide:
accepted.x: PM eVIDYA was introduced by the Ministry of Education in 2020 as a unified multi-mode digital education initiative.
accepted.tq: Associate the launch year with the initiative’s education-delivery purpose.
accepted.sec: Education e-services - launching body or operator  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: DIKSHA — Ministry of Health and Family Welfare — telemedicine
e-Pathshala — NCERT — e-textbooks and educational resources
Shiksha Vani — Ministry of Road Transport and Highways — driving licence applications
accepted.x: e-Pathshala is an NCERT platform providing e-textbooks and educational resources. Shiksha Vani is a CBSE podcast app, while DIKSHA and SWAYAM have the functions stated elsewhere.
accepted.tq: Match both the launching body and the specific educational format before choosing.
accepted.sec: Education e-services - launching body or operator  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission was launched in 2021 by the:
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
accepted.x: ABDM was launched in 2021 by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to create a national interoperable digital health ecosystem.
accepted.tq: Use the health-sector objective to identify the responsible ministry.
accepted.sec: Health e-services - ABDM components (ABHA, HPR, HFR)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes ABHA?
o: An interoperable repository of hospital equipment
A registry of verified health facilities
accepted.x: ABHA is the 14-digit health ID under ABDM.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the individual identifier from the facility and practitioner registries.
accepted.sec: Health e-services - ABDM components (ABHA, HPR, HFR)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding ABDM components:
1. HFR is a registry of verified public and private health facilities.
2. HPR is a registry of credentialed healthcare practitioners.
3. Linked records refer to interoperable health records.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly describe HFR, HPR and linked records under ABDM.
accepted.tq: Separate the facility registry, practitioner registry and health-record function before selecting the code.
accepted.sec: Health e-services - ABDM components (ABHA, HPR, HFR)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: As reported for August 2025, which ABDM component had the largest numerical count among the following?
accepted.x: ABHA had 79.91 crore IDs, exceeding the 67.19 crore linked records and the counts of HFR and HPR entries.
accepted.tq: Compare the units and magnitudes rather than confusing crore figures with registry counts.
accepted.sec: Health e-services - ABDM components (ABHA, HPR, HFR)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly presents the ABDM figures reported for August 2025?
o: ABHA — 79.91 crore IDs; HFR — 4,18,964 facilities; HPR — 6,79,692 practitioners
ABHA — 67.19 crore IDs; HFR — 6,79,692 facilities; HPR — 4,18,964 practitioners
ABHA — 4,18,964 IDs; HFR — 79.91 crore facilities; HPR — 67.19 crore practitioners
ABHA — 6,79,692 IDs; HFR — 67.19 crore facilities; HPR — 79.91 crore practitioners
accepted.x: The reported figures are 79.91 crore ABHA IDs, 4,18,964 HFR entries and 6,79,692 HPR entries. Linked records stood at 67.19 crore.
accepted.tq: Keep the component labels attached to their exact numerical values and units.
accepted.sec: Health e-services - ABDM components (ABHA, HPR, HFR)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is associated with medicine procurement and supply-chain management rather than with an ABDM identity or registry component?
accepted.x: e-Aushadhi is related to medicine procurement and supply-chain management. ABHA, HPR and HFR are ABDM components.
accepted.tq: Identify the item outside the identity-and-registry group by its supply-chain function.
accepted.sec: Health e-services - ABDM components (ABHA, HPR, HFR)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following are related digital health services or initiatives mentioned alongside ABDM?
1. e-Aushadhi
2. CoWIN
3. Aarogya Setu
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: e-Aushadhi, CoWIN and Aarogya Setu are all related digital health services or initiatives associated with the ABDM context.
accepted.tq: Check whether each named service belongs to the wider digital-health group, not whether it is an ABDM component.
accepted.sec: Health e-services - ABDM components (ABHA, HPR, HFR)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): ABDM is designed as a national interoperable digital health ecosystem.
Reason (R): Its framework includes health IDs, registries of facilities and practitioners, and interoperable linked health records.

Select the correct answer using the code below.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both the assertion and reason are true. The combination of identity, registries and interoperable records explains ABDM’s ecosystem-wide design.
accepted.tq: Test whether the reason directly explains the stated system-wide objective.
accepted.sec: Health e-services - ABDM components (ABHA, HPR, HFR)  [APPSC]
